verdict.rationale: Harbor Compliance publishes a public, keyless OpenAPI v3 document with OAuth client-credentials auth, rate-limit headers and idempotency keys, so a documented programmatic API clearly exists. The probe found registered-agent-deliveries read endpoints but no registered-agent appointment endpoints. Entity-record endpoints are not explicitly shown, and create/update/delete requires Harbor to explicitly grant capabilities to the account. Missing for 10: confirmed entity-record read/write endpoints, registered-agent appointment management endpoints, write access available without a vendor grant, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
